ex.en: I fully agree with your point of view.
ex.zh: 我完全贊成你的觀點。

ex.en: From my point of view, cars do more harm than good.
ex.zh: 在我看來，汽車弊大於利。

ex.en: I understood Tom's point of view.
ex.zh: 我理解湯姆的觀點。

ex.en: Our brand positioning focuses on quality, not low prices.
ex.zh: 我們的品牌定位著重品質，而非低價。

ex.en: The product failed because of poor positioning.
ex.zh: 這項產品因為定位不佳而失敗。

ex.en: This policy resulted in a great rise in prices.
ex.zh: 這項政策導致物價大幅上漲。

ex.en: In order to alleviate employment pressures, the nation has established a series of relevant policies.
ex.zh: 為了緩解就業壓力，國家已經制定了一系列相關政策。

ex.en: He had decided on a new policy.
ex.zh: 他已經決定了新的政策。

ex.en: Our return policy allows refunds within 30 days.
ex.zh: 我們的退貨規定是 30 天內可以退款。

ex.en: Company policy does not allow pets in the office.
ex.zh: 公司規定辦公室裡不能帶寵物。

ex.en: Read your insurance policy carefully.
ex.zh: 請仔細閱讀你的保單。

ex.en: The policy covers fire and theft.
ex.zh: 這份保單涵蓋火災和竊盜。

ex.en: The police got to the scene of the accident.
ex.zh: 警方抵達了事故現場。

ex.en: The police are investigating the cause of the accident.
ex.zh: 警方正在調查事故原因。

ex.en: The fire station is next to the police station.
ex.zh: 消防局在警察局的旁邊。

ex.en: Tom probably knows why the meeting was postponed.
ex.zh: 湯姆大概知道會議延期的原因。

ex.en: Their trip was postponed because of the rain.
ex.zh: 他們的旅行因為下雨延期了。

ex.en: Bob suggested postponing the party till Wednesday.
ex.zh: 鮑伯建議將聚會延後到週三。

ex.en: He pointed out how important it is to observe the law.
ex.zh: 他指出了遵守法律的重要性。

ex.en: The teacher pointed out your mistakes.
ex.zh: 老師指出了你的錯誤。

ex.en: Excuse me; allow me to point out three errors in the above article.
ex.zh: 抱歉，請允許我指出上文中的三個錯誤。

ex.en: Do you think he is good for the position?
ex.zh: 你認為他適合這個職位嗎？

ex.en: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
ex.zh: 這份職位要求應徵者有一定的英語口語表達能力。

ex.en: Many people get a job in customer services before they are qualified for other positions.
ex.zh: 許多人在有資格擔任其他職位之前，會先從客服工作做起。

ex.en: The soldiers retreated from their positions.
ex.zh: 士兵們撤離了陣地。

ex.en: I'm not in a position to make that decision.
ex.zh: 我沒有立場做這個決定。

ex.en: Designers usually bring a portfolio to the interview.
ex.zh: 設計師面試時通常會帶作品集。

ex.en: Her online portfolio shows her best photos.
ex.zh: 她的線上作品集展示了她最好的照片。

ex.en: It's wise to have a diverse investment portfolio.
ex.zh: 擁有多元的投資組合是明智的。

ex.en: He reviews his portfolio once a month.
ex.zh: 他每個月檢視一次自己的投資組合。
